'''Blackwing Crystals''' were unusual [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] generated in contact with the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] bioweapon that transforms its victims into [[Zombie/Legends|undead cannibals]]. When used in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], they produced a dark, smokey ash blade.<ref name="SWG:BC" /> Such crystals were found in the caves of the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] during a [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|Blackwing virus outbreak]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a group of spacers defeated a giant [[undead rancor]] in a cave below the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] where the virus escaped containment and they found a collection of these crystals.<ref name="SWG:GEUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blackwing Crystal appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Blackwing Crystal was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
